name: xunlei-ai-task-agent
description: A high-fidelity Electron demo for Xunlei AI Task Agent.
author: yogurt-stack

scripts.build: npm run clean:build && npm run verify:catalog && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run verify:catalog && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.verify:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run verify:agent-core && npm run verify:model-client && npm run verify:download-client && npm run verify:persistence && npm run verify:p0-resource-orchestration && npm run verify:p1-supply-chain-resilience && npm run verify:p2-platform-extensibility && npm run verify:p3-demo-distribution && npm run verify:windows-packaging && npm run verify:production-build
scripts.package:win:dir: npm run build && npm run clean:package && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run clean:package && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
